criteria.answered: the owner asked a question or for information, and the message gives the answer
criteria.done: the agent finished the task and checked it, and gives the result; no open work for itself
criteria.handing_back: the agent ends its turn while reversible work remains: it asks 'want me to...?' or 'shall I...?' about something it could just do, hands the owner commands to run, lists options instead of picking a default, or says it will wait for a go-ahead
criteria.owner_only: needs the owner personally: rotating their passwords or tokens, account logins, payments, deleting their only copy of data, publishing to a third party, or destroying work the agent does not own (another session's files or processes, the owner's data, a shared host); stopping to ask before any of these is correct
criteria.waiting_on_background: background workers or jobs are running and will report back on their own; the agent only says it is waiting for them
